entries.rawMarkdown:
## Hapla 1 - 2026-08-01

Hapla introduces a Web-first workspace for Codex CLI and Claude Code with responsive Normal and Coder modes.

- Dynamic model and reasoning-effort catalogs from each installed CLI
- Custom per-session environment variables for compatible API providers
- Coder workspace with terminal, file browser, and media previews
- Interactive Skills powered by Codex App Server and MCP Apps
- Responsive image and video galleries for desktop and phone browsers
